title: DiSCo: A Distribution-First Steering and Cultural Prior Evaluation Framework for Measuring Cultural Preference Bias in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the baseline selection distribution and steerability of LLMs in forced-choice multiple-choice scenarios, where all options are equally valid culturally grounded lifestyle choices, to measure deviations from a uniform distribution using metrics like KL divergence, Gini coefficient, and Statistical Parity Difference.
